meta.title: Budget brake
meta.description: Warns the model as the budget nears its limit and stops the turn when the budget is spent, the window is full, or steps stop making progress.

config.profile: Profile label in the log row
config.warnPct: Share of the budget that triggers the warning, %
config.noProgressSteps: Steps without progress before the stop (0 — off)
config.repeatErrors: Repeats of one tool error before the stop (0 — off)
config.prices: Per-model prices overriding the built-in table
